r.문화권·종교: Malay · Islam is the state religion
r.경제 체제: Oil and gas economy · almost no taxes on citizens
r.생활 물가 수준: 40% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 52%, Hot-rolled steel 16%, Wire, cable 4%, Cosmetics 4% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Natural gas (LNG, LPG) 94% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-ASEAN FTA (in force 2007); RCEP (in force for Korea since 2022; multilateral)
r.정치 구도: An absolute monarchy in which the sultan is both head of state and prime minister.

t.why: Its claims in the South China Sea overlap with China's, but it rarely presses them.
t.rel: A small oil producer on northern Borneo, surrounded by Malaysia. Its South China Sea claims overlap with China's, but it rarely presses them.
t.know: Incomes are so high that there is no income tax, and education and health care are nearly free.
t.etext: Oil and natural gas make up most exports and government revenue. With that money, it collects almost no taxes from citizens. It aims to expand into petrochemicals in preparation for the day its resources run out.
